name: Mortgages & Home Lending
description: Residential and commercial mortgage lending — prime, specialist, investment, SMSF, and construction lending. Largest balance sheet item for most Australian banks.

name: Retail Banking & Deposits
description: Consumer deposit accounts, everyday banking, debit cards, and personal overdrafts. The foundation of the retail banking franchise.

name: Business & Commercial Lending
description: SME and commercial lending — term loans, equipment finance, trade finance, and working capital. Broker and direct origination.

name: Payments & Transaction Banking
description: Consumer and business payments — cards, NPP, SWIFT, direct entry, PayID, and merchant acquiring.

name: Wealth & Investment
description: Financial advice, portfolio management, superannuation, and investment products. FASEA best interests duty and MiFID II suitability obligations.

name: Insurance
description: General, life, and health insurance underwriting, policy administration, and claims management.
